class.name: VehicleTelemetry
class.brief_description: Telemetry node that reads and exposes vehicle drivetrain data for UI or debugging.
class.description:
VehicleTelemetry is a [Node] that automatically reads drivetrain state from a [Vehicle] node and exposes it through readable properties. It can auto-detect its target [Vehicle] by checking the parent or sibling nodes, or you can assign one manually via [method set_target].
Use this node to display real-time vehicle data such as RPM, speed, gear, and clutch engagement in a HUD or debug overlay.

method.name: set_target
method.description: Sets the target [Vehicle] node to read telemetry from.

method.name: get_engine_torque
method.description: Returns the current engine torque output in Nm.

method.name: get_engine_throttle
method.description: Returns the current engine throttle position (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: get_driveshaft_twist
method.description: Returns the current driveshaft twist (angular displacement).

method.name: get_clutch_engagement
method.description: Returns the current clutch engagement value (0.0 = disengaged, 1.0 = fully engaged).

method.name: get_current_gear
method.description: Returns the current gear number. 0 is neutral, 1+ are forward gears.

method.name: get_gear_ratio
method.description: Returns the current effective gear ratio (gear ratio × final drive).

method.name: get_vehicle_speed_kph
method.description: Returns the vehicle's speed in kilometers per hour.
